design_origin: specified after GeoLifeCLEF development; external assessment outcomes not inspected
cohort: previously audited conservative non-European cells; all contributing metadata satisfy original rules; consistent country and continent required
area_provenance_admission: before outcomes, exclude cells whose released sampled_area_m2 differs from sum of linked unique-plot areas (atol 0.1 m2, rtol 0.0001); metadata may omit contributing plots; no claim that equality proves completeness
published_backbone_training_overlap: SAGE PO training can include evaluation cells; holdout applies to this reliability study, not a claim of spatially disjoint backbone training
probability_calibration: one shared Platt slope/intercept per frozen model, native-range-eligible pairs only, fit assigned probability-calibration rows
threshold_selection: highest probability-calibration sample F1, first grid entry breaks ties
empty_set_convention: F1(empty,empty)=1; secondary zero-divisor-zero sensitivity also reported
empty_prediction_confidence: product of (1-p) over eligible species, conditional-independence plug-in heuristic
selection_policy: fixed country by calibration-defined plot-area-bin quotas; largest remainder; target 80 percent
rare_definition: bottom quintile of positive finite PO relative prevalence from released species_properties_1km.csv; ties included
secondary_rarity: 1 to 25 positives in probability-calibration rows, not assessment
mass_constraint: retain at least survey-coverage fraction of total predicted ecological mass within the same fixed group quotas; Lagrangian search, no optimality or true-coverage guarantee
primary_method: SDC loss ordering with supervised rare-count proxy constraint
primary_baseline: unconstrained SDC loss ordering under identical country/area quotas
primary_inference: joint paired 5-degree block bootstrap over the same assessment cells and all four models; 2000 draws, seed 20261116; 97.5 percent intervals for F1 and rare-coverage endpoints; model-wise outcomes also reported
replication_scope: prospective locked analysis of a published benchmark subset; not a secret test or proof of global ecological causality
secondary_analyses: decoder interactions, learned vs SDC confidence, entropy, source/continent/country, rare precision/recall and retention, proxy feasibility and referral-cost interpretation
primary_success_rule: admission rare-count threshold met; mean rare-coverage gain >=0.03 and its 97.5% interval lower bound >0; mean F1-gain interval lower bound >=-0.005; every model point F1 gain >=-0.005 and realized rare occurrence coverage >=0.78
calibration_numerics: 512-bin logit sufficient-statistic approximation with fixed [-16,16] edges; optimize pooled binary NLL on eligible probability-calibration pairs
